faq.q: Can I change or cancel my plan?
faq.a: Yes. You can upgrade, downgrade or cancel from Billing in your dashboard. If you cancel, your plan keeps running until the end of the period you’ve paid for.
By card through Stripe’s secure checkout. We never see or store your card details, and you get an invoice for every payment.

faq.q: What happens to my data if I leave?
faq.a: Your applications and resumes stay visible to you. You can export your data or ask us to delete your account from Settings.

how.title: We apply. You interview.
how.sub: A dedicated specialist runs your job search every weekday, with a resume tailored to each job. Here’s exactly what happens, and what you’ll see.
how.timelineTitle: Your first week, and every week after

timeline.title: Sign up and onboard
timeline.body: Choose a plan and pay securely. A specialist is assigned to you automatically, usually within minutes. A short onboarding asks for your resume, the roles you want and where you want to work.
points: Pick a plan — no call required
Tell us your target roles, locations and salary

timeline.title: Your master resume is ready
timeline.body: We turn your experience into a structured master profile and a clean base resume. You review it and tell us what to fix. It becomes the single source of truth for every tailored version.
points: Structured profile of your real experience
Base resume in your market’s style
You approve it before we apply

timeline.title: Tailored applications
timeline.body: Your specialist finds relevant openings, tailors your resume to each job description and applies. Every application appears on your dashboard with the exact resume that was sent.
points: {min}–{max} applications a weekday, depending on your plan
A tailored resume for each job
Logged live with the job link

timeline.title: You interview, we keep going
timeline.body: When a recruiter replies or an interview lands, it shows on your dashboard. You prepare with mock interviews and targeted material while we keep the pipeline full.
points: We keep applying until you accept an offer

how.needSub: About 20 minutes during onboarding. After that, your time goes into interviews.

needs.title: Your resume
needs.body: Your current resume (PDF or Word). We use only what’s true in it and anything you add to your profile.

needs.title: Your preferences
needs.body: Target job titles, seniority, locations, remote or on-site, salary expectations, work authorisation and companies to avoid.

needs.title: Portal access
needs.body: The email and job-portal logins we’ll apply with, stored in an encrypted vault, plus your written authorisation to apply on your behalf.

how.dailySub: Every application, with the company, role, date and time in your time zone, job link, status and the exact resume used.
how.tailorSub: Tailoring means emphasising what you’ve really done that matters for this job. It never means inventing.

tailorSteps.title: Read the job description
tailorSteps.body: We pull out the skills, tools and responsibilities the employer is asking for.

tailorSteps.title: Match your real experience
tailorSteps.body: We find the parts of your master profile that prove you can do the job.

tailorSteps.title: Rewrite and reorder
tailorSteps.body: Your summary, skills and bullet points are rewritten around the job’s language, in your market’s resume style.

tailorSteps.title: Check before sending
tailorSteps.body: A validator rejects anything not in your profile, and your specialist reviews the resume before applying.

how.truth: We never add a company, job title, date or skill you don’t have.

ethics.q: Is it okay for someone else to apply on my behalf?
ethics.a: Yes, with your permission. You authorise us in writing during onboarding, you choose the roles and companies, and every application is visible to you as soon as it’s sent.
Some job portals’ terms restrict sharing your account. We show you a plain-language notice about this during onboarding, and you decide whether to go ahead.

ethics.q: Will you ever exaggerate my experience?
ethics.a: No. Tailored resumes only use experience, skills and dates from your master profile. An automatic check blocks anything that isn’t there.
Only your assigned specialist, and only while they’re assigned to you. Every reveal is logged, admins can’t see the values, and you can change or delete them at any time.

ethics.q: Can I stop at any time?
ethics.a: Yes. Cancel from Billing whenever you like. Your plan runs to the end of the period you’ve paid for, and your history stays available to you.

about.title: Your time belongs in interviews
about.sub: UpayaInd is a done-for-you job application service. Our specialists apply for you every weekday with a resume tailored to each job, so you can focus on preparing, upskilling and getting hired.
about.mission: Job hunting shouldn’t mean hundreds of hours of copying the same details into the same forms. We take on the repetitive work — finding roles, tailoring resumes and applying — and make it completely transparent, so you always know what was sent, where and when.

values.title: Truthful resumes
values.body: We tailor, we never invent. Every resume uses only your real experience.

values.title: Full transparency
values.body: Every application is on your dashboard with the job link and the exact resume used.

values.title: Your data, protected
values.body: Logins are encrypted, files are private and every access by our team is logged.
